incremental.bootstrap_policy: first INCREMENTAL requires explicit bounded from/to and freezes from as checkpoint anchor; no unbounded history default
incremental.revision_overlap: re-fetch from max(anchor, verifiedThrough - 5 calendar days) and advance only after all date slices and row readbacks verify
incremental.checkpoint_policy: only contiguous same-target VERIFIED/VERIFIED_EMPTY INCREMENTAL intervals with exact frozen definition, bootstrap anchor, calendar dates and valid source receipts advance; BACKFILL/RECONCILE do not
incremental.target_range_policy: reads actual distinct physical trade dates and reconciles every date/value against latest date-specific receipt in the selected incremental chain; latest receipt ordered by summary.updatedAt, run ID only stable tie-breaker; unexplained dates fail closed

completed_day_policy.rule: programmatic null end defaults from frozen logicalDate; CLI still requires --to; both default and explicit end are capped at yesterday before 20:30 or today at/after 20:30, and final frozen end cannot exceed logicalDate
completed_day_policy.physical_target_guard: incremental catch-up fails closed if existing max trade_date exceeds the completed-source ceiling

calendar_policy.legacy_contract: Python get_trading_dates_between uses complete SSE rows for every calendar day and returns SSE open dates only
calendar_policy.d001_observation: Read-only QuestDB inventory contains SSE and SZSE only, no BSE; bounded 2026-09-28..2026-09-30 query returned both exchanges open on all three dates and no BSE rows
calendar_policy.d010_behavior: Schedules one unfiltered all-market stk_limit request on each SSE open date; retains .BJ/BSE codes without filtering; does not union SSE/SZSE dates
calendar_policy.limitation: BSE-specific session parity is not proven without BSE calendar rows and remains a verification limitation

source.route_policy: exact one-date all-market request with explicit fields ts_code,trade_date,up_limit,down_limit; undocumented paging/code inventory fallback is not used
source.cap_policy: response at 5800 rows is persisted as unverified raw evidence and rejected before row consumption/write
source.requests_sent_note: Completed source pages recorded; transport retries not inferred.
source.row_count_scope: Four acceptance runs including repeated keys; recovery separately recorded.

write.row_count_scope: Four acceptance runs; no inferred insert/update split; recovery separately linked.

checks.rate_limit: Configured endpoint 10/min and global 20/min used; no natural provider throttling claimed
checks.retry: Shared bounded retry path; natural transport retry not counted as a separate acceptance assertion
checks.pagination: Complete bounded one-date source responses below declared cap; no offset/cursor used
checks.resume: 5648 refetched rows independently revalidated, zero resend
checks.cancel: Before-source zero rows and after-verified-page 5648 rows CANCELLED
checks.unknown_write_reconcile: Injected acknowledgement loss after sender closure; two actual rows read back UNKNOWN_RECONCILED
checks.gradle_build: Task sources and operational tools compiled with Java 24 against private dependency snapshot; no full Gradle build or test-suite rerun claimed
checks.live_tushare: Four nonempty real source runs; original field values retained in receipts
checks.live_questdb_isolated_readback: Exact keys and every physical field MATCHED; whole isolated table census has no duplicate keys
checks.receipt_identity: Raw field values preserved; rows ordered by full business key and JSON maps sorted before hashing, making recovery insensitive to response order
checks.fresh_process_cli_recovery: VERIFIED; frozen prior request restored with --resume-from alone; 5648 rows reused and independently matched
